rich.13fb0f6792ca.source:
Web course

Securing Agents with OpenShell and NemoClaw

4 modules

Modern agents are everywhere, and they’re conceptually simple: a model wired to tools, memory, and a routing decision that keeps running until the task is done. This course starts by building such a system from scratch, then connects those ideas to modern frameworks used by software engineers and non‑technical users alike. You’ll go from a single API call to agent coordination, grounded retrieval, deep planning, and safe deployment using NVIDIA OpenClaw and NemoClaw™.

Start the course →
rich.13fb0f6792ca.value:
Web 课程

使用 OpenShell 和 NemoClaw 构建安全智能体

4 个模块

如今，智能体无处不在，其概念并不复杂：将模型与工具、记忆和路由决策连接起来，持续运行直至任务完成。本课程将从零开始构建这样的系统，再把其中的理念与软件工程师和非技术用户都在使用的现代框架联系起来。您将从一次 API 调用起步，逐步学习智能体协作、基于可靠依据的检索、深度规划，以及如何使用 NVIDIA OpenClaw 和 NemoClaw™ 进行安全部署。

开始学习课程 →

rich.c13508385726.source: No setup needed. In the lab, every page already routes through the course model gateway, so the cells just work. Inside edX the text reads fine, but the live cells there need your own API key, which each course page lets you set.
rich.c13508385726.value: 无需设置。在实验中，每个页面都已通过课程模型网关完成路由，因此单元可直接运行。在 edX 中，文本内容可以正常阅读，但其中的实时单元需要使用您自己的 API key；可以在各课程页面中进行设置。
